title: FBI Photo B018
sensor_system_note: B-series — large full-frame crosshair reticle, '12/31/99 HH:MM:SS' factory-reset sensor clock visible bottom-left, scale markings '15 10 5 | 5 10 15' in burst-1 / early burst-2 and '3' after the high-mag zoom at B022. Sky/atmosphere background throughout (no terrain in burst 2). Different sensor system from A-series.

pages.description: A grainy grayscale image resembling a targeting or sensor display with a noisy gray background. A white crosshair reticle is centered, consisting of a vertical line and a horizontal line that intersect near the middle, with tick marks and the numeral '3' marked at the left and right ends of the horizontal line. Near the center-right of the crosshair is a small dark blob-like shape. Several black rectangular bars (appearing to be redactions or masked areas) are positioned around the frame: a large one across the top, and smaller ones on the left and right sides at upper, middle, and lower positions, some with lighter gray extensions. A timestamp overlay appears in the lower-left corner reading '12/31/99 18:21:02'.
